question: Which sector suffered due to reduction in fertilizer subsidies post-1991?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 

• **Reduction in fertilizer subsidies post-1991:** During the economic reforms of **1991**, the Government of India reduced subsidies on fertilizers to address fiscal imbalances. This move significantly impacted the **Agriculture sector**, as farmers had to bear higher costs for fertilizers. 

• **Impact on farmers:** Fertilizers are essential for enhancing soil fertility and crop yield. The reduction in subsidies increased the cost of agricultural inputs, directly affecting the financial burden on **small and marginal farmers**. 

• **Decline in agricultural productivity:** Many farmers reduced fertilizer usage due to higher costs, leading to a **decline in agricultural productivity** in several regions, especially those dependent on fertilizer-intensive farming methods.
